verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe Gemini in BigQuery as a built-in assistant that generates and suggests SQL or Python code and explains existing SQL queries (docs-5). It can also generate, complete and summarize code from natural-language prompts (docs-66). It finds, joins and queries table assets from natural language (docs-39), offers conversational analytics over your data (docs-71), and generates queries from table metadata (docs-72). Missing for 10: no documented SQL error-fixing or debugging capability, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of how well generation works against real schemas.
